answer: To blunt sybil farms, require each newcomer to complete a voyage of work whose timing cannot be cloned in lockstep. Independent attestors sample the pulse of that record and accept a countersignature only when the operational cipher — tool mix, latency jitter, and topical spread — is unlike any cluster they already signed. Correlated look-alikes collapse into one identity, and the shared bond stays locked, so mass-minted accounts cannot outvote authentic ones.
